grants.description: Verify your identity as a legitimate employer authorized to conduct right to work checks
grants.purpose: To ensure only authorized employers can verify right to work and to maintain audit trail

grants.description: Share applicant's right to work status with employer via Home Office online service
grants.purpose: To verify the applicant has the legal right to work in the UK for the employer

grants.description: Copy and retain applicant's right to work documents
grants.purpose: To maintain evidence of right to work check as required by law and protect against civil penalties

grants.description: Store copies of documents and check records for duration of employment plus 2 years
grants.purpose: Legal requirement to maintain audit trail and demonstrate compliance with right to work legislation

revocation.mechanism: Employer must delete records after 2 years post-employment. Applicant can request Home Office to revoke share code access.
revocation.effect: Employer loses statutory excuse if records are not kept for required duration. Revoked share codes cannot be used for verification.

delegation.limitations: Agent cannot make final hiring decision. Agent cannot override document verification failures. Agent cannot access Home Office systems directly - only through approved share code mechanism. Agent must flag edge cases requiring human review (e.g., Certificate of Application, pre-1989 arrivals).
